articles.title: Cooler weather and potential rain move into the French region torched by wildfires
articles.description: Higher humidity, cooler temperatures and a forecast for rain raised hopes of relief Thursday for a parched portion of southwestern France engulfed by wildfires that have charred an area four times the size of Paris in recent weeks.
